Future<void> run(List<List<Item>> groups) async {
  for (final batch in groups) {
    Future<void> saveOne(Item item) async {
      await save(item);
      await audit(item);
    }

    await Future.wait(batch.map(saveOne));
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    try {
      await Future.wait(batch.map(save));
    } catch (error) {
      log(error);
    }
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    if (batch.isNotEmpty) await Future.wait(batch.map(save));
  }
}
